response.sql: SELECT orders.orderbase AS channel, AVG(orderexecutions.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT orders.orderspivot) AS distinct_order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT orders.orderspivot) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT orders.orderspivot)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM orders INNER JOIN orderexecutions ON orderexecutions.ordersmark = orders.recordvault GROUP BY orders.orderbase
